parsed.why: Thin record: entrenched stigma, no anti-discrimination law, no documented acceptance, police mistreatment of LGBTQ documented, public-morals offence reaching relationships read as same-sex; no trans-specific rule or relief recorded.

Decriminalised, no presentation offence or facility ban, official guidance protective, but documented police dismissal of trans assault complaints yields impunity, plus healthcare/service stigma and absent recognition or anti-discrimination law.

Sodomy felony upheld, routine police extortion of gender-nonconforming people, documented trans prison abuse with impunity, hostile society — offset partly by courts repeatedly granting trans relief, unimplemented.

Self-ID, marriage equality, hate-crime provision and national action plan, strong rule of law; negatives are rising raw hate-crime counts, sexual-orientation-framed statute, cantonal detention wording, no national placement rule.

Fresh criminalisation under military rule: 2-5 years plus stated deportation of foreign nationals, promotion ban, no LGBTQ organisations or violence recourse, witch-hunt fear; no prosecutions yet, but hostile state and no protections.
